name: Vantage Dashboard for WooCommerce
author: thewagenleitergroup

sections.description:
Vantage puts the numbers that matter for your store on one screen: revenue, orders, average order value, refunds and conversion rate, for today, this month and this year. It reads your WooCommerce orders directly, keeps a compact daily summary so the dashboard stays fast, and never needs an external service for the basics.

What the free version includes

  • Today’s Pulse, Monthly Pacing and Annual Trajectory. Each period shows where you are, where you are heading at the current pace, and how that compares with the same stretch of the previous period.
  • Historical Trends. Revenue and orders over any range you choose, day by day or month by month.
  • Top Products and Top Categories, with each one’s share of revenue.
  • Payment Channels. Which gateways your customers pay with, and what each brings in.
  • Top Coupons. Which codes are used, and how much discount each one has given away.
  • Conversion rate, when you connect a visitor source: Google Analytics 4, Plausible or Jetpack Stats — whichever you already use. None is required; orders and revenue always come from WooCommerce itself.
  • PDF export of the dashboard for any date range.
  • The same widgets on the WordPress dashboard, if you prefer them there.

Built for real stores

Vantage keeps a compact daily summary table rather than querying your orders on every page load, so the dashboard stays fast on stores with hundreds of thousands of orders. It supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and legacy post storage, works with or without a persistent object cache, and lets you choose which order statuses count as revenue.

Available in English, German, Spanish and French.

Vantage Dashboard Ultimate

A paid version with more reports is available at vantageplugins.net. It is not required — the free version works on its own, and nothing in it expires.

Ultimate adds:

  • True net profit. Record a cost per product and variation; the cost is captured on each order as it is placed, so changing a price later does not rewrite past margins. Payment fees are taken from the order where your gateway records them. Long-Term Profitability and Profitability by Product build on this.
  • Advertising. Daily spend from Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads next to the revenue for the same day, with ROAS and profit after advertising.
  • Where your customers come from. Traffic Sources, the Device Performance Matrix, High-Intent Search Terms, Top Performing Content, and Organic SEO Keywords from Google Search Console.
  • Customers and history. Top Customers, Geographical Statistics, Long-Term History and Refund History.
  • AI, with your own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini or DeepSeek): a written Daily Briefing, revenue projections, product bundle suggestions and a chat assistant that answers questions about your store.
  • Agency reports. Share links for clients, optionally password-protected and set to expire.
  • Your own branding on the dashboard, the PDF and shared reports, and default ranges and sizes for every widget.

Source code and build process

Everything in assets/js/ is written by hand and ships exactly as written; those files are the source, and
nothing there is minified or generated.

Four files are built: the Chart.js and jsPDF bundles in assets/vendor/, and the two compiled Tailwind
stylesheets in assets/css/. Their sources ship with the plugin in build-src/, together with build-src/BUILD.md,
which lists the libraries and versions, the commands that build each file, and how to rebuild them with esbuild
and the Tailwind CLI.

External services

Vantage connects to third-party services only for features you enable. No store data is sent anywhere unless you connect the corresponding service, and none of these connections is required: the dashboard’s revenue, orders, pacing and profit figures are read from your own WooCommerce data. Services marked (Ultimate) are used only by Vantage Dashboard Ultimate; the free version does not contact them.

Vantage Plugins OAuth bridge (vantageplugins.net)

Used to connect Google Analytics (and, in Ultimate, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads) without storing the OAuth app secrets in the plugin.

What is sent, and when: clicking a Connect button sends you to the bridge, which forwards you to the provider’s sign-in page; the bridge then receives the one-time authorisation code from the provider and exchanges it for tokens, which it returns to your site. Afterwards, whenever the plugin needs a new access token (during a sync, or when loading your list of properties or ad accounts), it sends the stored refresh token to the bridge and receives a short-lived access token in return. No store, order or customer data is ever sent to the bridge.

Terms of service: https://www.vantageplugins.net/terms-of-service/ – Privacy policy: https://www.vantageplugins.net/privacy-policy/

Google Analytics Data API

Used when Google Analytics 4 is selected as the analytics engine. The plugin requests aggregated visitor and add-to-cart statistics for your property and chosen date ranges; Ultimate also requests traffic channel, device, search term and page view statistics.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms – Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Search Console API (Ultimate)

Used when a Search Console property is selected. The plugin requests the search queries, clicks and impressions for your site.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms – Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Ads API (Ultimate)

Used when Google Ads is connected. The plugin requests daily ad spend for your customer ID.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms – Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Meta Marketing API (graph.facebook.com) (Ultimate)

Used when Meta Ads is connected. The plugin requests daily ad spend for your ad account.
Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms – Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy

TikTok for Business API (Ultimate)

Used when TikTok Ads is connected. The plugin requests daily ad spend for your advertiser account.
Terms: https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/terms – Privacy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/privacy-policy

Plausible Analytics

Used when Plausible is selected as the analytics engine. The plugin requests aggregated visitor statistics for your domain; Ultimate also requests traffic source, search term and page statistics.
Terms: https://plausible.io/terms – Privacy: https://plausible.io/privacy

Jetpack Stats (WordPress.com)

Used when Jetpack Stats is selected as the analytics engine, through your existing Jetpack connection. The plugin requests visitor, referrer, search term and top post statistics.
Terms: https://wordpress.com/tos/ – Privacy: https://automattic.com/privacy/

AI providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek (Ultimate)

Used only for AI features, and only with the provider you select and your own API key. Requests contain aggregated store metrics (for example revenue totals, order counts, conversion rate, top product and traffic source names), product names, prices and short descriptions for bundle suggestions, the customer name, order count, total spend and last order date for generated emails, and the question you type into the chat assistant together with the database query results needed to answer it. The plugin also lists the models your key can use.
Anthropic terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms – Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
OpenAI terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use – Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
Google terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms – Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
DeepSeek terms: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-open-platform-terms-of-service.html – Privacy: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html

Vantage Plugins AI model list (vantageplugins.net) (Ultimate)

When an AI provider is connected, the plugin downloads a small public list of recommended AI models from https://www.vantageplugins.net/bridges/ai-models.json about twice a day, so new models can be recommended without a plugin update. The request contains no store data.
Terms of service: https://www.vantageplugins.net/terms-of-service/ – Privacy policy: https://www.vantageplugins.net/privacy-policy/

Freemius

Freemius provides the opt-in shown after activation, and the licensing and updates for Vantage Dashboard Ultimate.

What is sent, and when: nothing until you agree. If you accept the opt-in, Freemius receives your site’s address, the WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, and the email address of the account that accepted it, so that product and security notices can reach you; you can skip the opt-in, and the plugin works exactly the same. Deactivating the plugin offers an optional feedback form, which sends only what you type. In Ultimate, activating a licence sends the licence key and the site address, which is what makes updates for the paid version possible.
Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ – Privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate Vantage Dashboard. The onboarding wizard opens automatically.
  4. Go to Vantage → Settings → Data & Sync and build the initial data cache.

The first sync reads your existing orders. You choose how far back to go — a shorter history syncs much faster, and you can widen it later.
sections.faq:
Do I need Google Analytics?

No. Orders and revenue come from WooCommerce itself. Connecting an analytics source adds the visitor side, which is what makes conversion rate possible.

Do I need an AI provider?

No. The AI features are part of Ultimate, and even there they are off until you add your own API key. Requests are billed to your own provider account — Vantage does not resell AI usage.

Does it work on a large store?

Yes. Vantage keeps a compact daily summary table and reads that, rather than querying your orders on every page load. It has been tested against stores in the tens of thousands of orders on both High-Performance Order Storage and legacy post storage.

Why don’t the numbers match WooCommerce Analytics exactly?

Vantage counts only the order statuses selected under Settings → Data & Sync → Included Order Statuses.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

Settings, connections and the reporting cache are removed. Product costs recorded with Ultimate, and the cost snapshots stored on past orders, are kept unless you tick “Also remove cost of goods data when the plugin is deleted” under Settings → Tools & Status before deleting.
